findings.title: One failing SendGrid cancel aborts the whole batch and skips all DB deletes
findings.body: In the new cancellation section, all SendGrid `POST /v3/user/scheduled_sends` calls are awaited sequentially inside a single try/catch, and the `prisma.workflowReminder.delete` promises are only executed via `Promise.all` after the loop. If any single `client.request` throws (e.g. an invalid/expired batch_id, a reminder whose referenceId is null, or a transient SendGrid error), the catch fires and (a) all remaining reminders in `remindersToCancel` are never cancelled at SendGrid, and (b) none of the reminder rows — including the ones that were successfully cancelled — are deleted from the DB. Those rows stay `cancelled: true` and are retried every 15 minutes, permanently failing behind the one bad record; meanwhile reminders whose scheduledDate passes before a successful run are removed by the top-of-handler deleteMany without ever being cancelled at SendGrid, so the email still goes out. Each reminder should be processed independently (try/catch inside the loop) and rows should be deleted once their cancellation succeeds.

findings.title: remindersToCancel query missing method/scheduled filters
findings.body: The query for reminders to cancel filters only on `cancelled: true` and scheduledDate, with no `method: WorkflowMethods.EMAIL` and no `scheduled: true` / `referenceId: { not: null }` constraint. Today only email reminders get `cancelled` set (SMS reminders are deleted immediately), but any SMS or unscheduled row that ever ends up with `cancelled: true` would be sent to SendGrid's scheduled_sends endpoint with a Twilio SID or null batch_id, which errors and — because of the shared try/catch — blocks cancellation of all legitimate email reminders in the same run. The query should restrict to scheduled email reminders with a non-null referenceId.

findings.title: immediateDelete path cancels at SendGrid but leaves stale WorkflowReminder row
findings.body: When `deleteScheduledEmailReminder` is called with `immediateDelete: true` (used for rescheduled bookings in handleNewBooking.ts and for deleted workflows/steps in workflows.tsx), it cancels the scheduled send at SendGrid but then returns without deleting the WorkflowReminder row or setting `cancelled`. The row remains with `scheduled: true` and a valid referenceId, so it lingers until the cron's past-date deleteMany cleans it up — for reminders scheduled close to 72h out that can be days. The row should be deleted (or marked cancelled) after the SendGrid cancellation succeeds, consistent with the SMS path in deleteScheduledSMSReminder which deletes the row.
